environment.description: IoT message ingestion service deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (no IGW, no NAT for inbound). Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer (NLB) registered as a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Consumer access requires: (1) the endpoint service has 'Require acceptance' enabled with an allowlist of 3 specific AWS account IDs corresponding to the IoT gateway fleet accounts, (2) the NLB target group health check path is /health on port 8443, (3) the Fargate task security group ingress is restricted to the NLB's elastic network interfaces only (sg-0fedcba987654321/32 prefix list pl-0abc123def456), (4) MongoDB DocumentDB cluster (not Atlas) resides in same VPC with security group allowing only the Fargate task SG as source. There is no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering to any VPC with internet access. DNS resolution for the endpoint service is private-only via Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint.

config.dns: private hosted zone, no public resolution
